model: Online broker FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route, net debt held at zero, capital retention charged on revenue growth)

equity_bridge.item: CSRC administrative penalty (RMB1.85bn proposed: RMB470m confiscation + RMB1.38bn fines)
equity_bridge.note: Provision booked Q1-2026 in Others,net (Q1-26 release: pre-adjustment NI HK$2,922.0m vs reported HK$831.0m). Pending final CSRC determination; deducted once here because it is excluded from the FY0 margin and the forward flows. A larger final penalty or further mainland sanctions are carried in the bear scenario, not here.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 24.6% diverges >30% from revenue (44.2%) and EPS (58.0%) CAGRs: equity is being distributed (US$2.60/ADS dividend Apr-26, ~US$418m buybacks since Nov-25, FY21-23 buybacks HK$5.2bn). None of these rates is a forward path: FY2025-H1-26 is a record trading-volume cycle (AI-stock US trading, HK IPO boom). The base driver path starts at +3% and fades to 3% terminal.
historical_growth.notes: All CAGRs on HKD millions to FY2025. EPS computed as net income / ordinary shares (CSV EPS column mixes bases). FCF CAGRs null: reported FCF is dominated by client-fund movements and is not an owner-FCF series for a broker. 5yr equity CAGR is inflated by the 2020-21 equity raises.

scenario_narratives.base: Trading activity normalises from the Q2-2026 record (HK$6.42tn volume, +78.8% YoY) as management already flagged Q3 moderation, so the next twelve months grow only ~3% on a record TTM base. Funded-account growth outside mainland China (Malaysia, Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, newly licensed Thailand; 800k net adds guided for 2026) then compounds revenue at ~9-11%, fading to 4% by year 10. Mainland China (~13% of funded accounts) winds down over the two-year campaign window and is absorbed in the growth path. Margin fades from 62% to 57% pre-tax as rate cuts compress the client-cash/margin spread and overseas customer acquisition stays expensive. The CSRC penalty settles near the RMB1.85bn provision.
scenario_narratives.bull: The international franchise keeps compounding near its current pace: overseas funded accounts and client assets grow 30-40% for another year, wealth management and the PantherTrade virtual-asset/crypto-financing products diversify revenue toward recurring fees, and the HK IPO pipeline stays open. Revenue grows 12% off the record base and 13-16% in years 2-4, scale holds the pre-tax margin at ~62%, the CSRC matter closes at or below the proposed penalty with no further sanctions, and the ADR discount narrows enough to justify a 13x terminal FCFE multiple.
scenario_narratives.bear: A retail-sentiment reversal (AI-stock unwind, HK IPO window shut) cuts trading volume and margin balances the way FY2022 did after the 2021 boom: revenue falls 22% then 5%, while Fed/HKMA cuts compress interest income at the same time. The eight-agency mainland campaign forces a faster, fuller exit of mainland clients than the mid-single-digit outflow management guided, the final CSRC penalty and the June-2026 US class action cost more than the provision, and compliance costs rise across eight licensing regimes. Pre-tax margin drops to ~50% before partly recovering to 53%, growth resumes at only 3-7%, and the stock keeps a structural China-ADR discount (10x terminal).

valuation_philosophy.summary: Futu is valued as the equity stream of a capital-light, regulated broker: net income after SBC and tax, less the equity it has to retain to grow its margin book and client assets, discounted at an 11.5% cost of equity with no net-debt or excess-cash adjustment. The valuation is in HKD and converted to USD per ADS (1 ADS = 8 ordinary shares) at the pegged rate. The key judgment is that TTM revenue is a cyclical peak, so the base case starts flat-ish and the weights lean bear.
key_risks_to_valuation: Trading-volume cyclicality: TTM revenue reflects a record trading cycle; each 10% drop in revenue moves the base value by more than 10% because costs are partly fixed
CSRC: the RMB1.85bn penalty is provisioned but not final; the eight-agency campaign could widen beyond mainland account closures
Interest-rate cuts compressing the ~43% of revenue that is interest income
Capital retention ratio (wc_capture_pct -150): a stricter capital regime for margin financing would cut distributable FCFE
China-ADR structural risks (HFCAA/PCAOB, Cayman holding structure) that terminal multiples may not fully capture
Currency: the CSV currency label is wrong (USD vs actual HKD); any consumer that trusts it will mis-scale by ~7.85x

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (NASDAQ, USD per ADS); 52-week range 80.50-202.53
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance HKD=X close 2026-10-03; cross-checked to the company's HK$7.8420 convenience rate (30-Jun-2026)
data_sources.financials: FUTU_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL, 20-F FY2017-FY2025; values are HKD millions despite the CSV's USD label), plus the Q1-2026 (6-K 2026-05-28) and Q2-2026 (6-K 2026-08-20) earnings releases for H1-26 income statement, 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet, SBC and diluted share count, and the 2-Apr-2026 dividend 6-K (US$2.60/ADS, ~US$365m)
data_sources.currency_bridge: Every flow is HKD millions; per-ADS value = HKD equity value / 140.02m ADS x 0.127448 USD/HKD. HKD-denominated twins are carried in the DCF JSON alongside the USD headline.

inputs.share_count_basis: ADS-equivalent, millions. Q2-2026 diluted weighted-average ordinary shares 1,120,132,347 (6-K ex99.1, 20-Aug-2026) / 8 ordinary shares per ADS = 140.02m ADS. Cross-check: April-2026 dividend of US$2.60/ADS totalled ~US$365m = ~140.4m ADS at the 16-Apr record date. NOTE: 1 ADS = 8 Class A ordinary shares (stated in the Q2-26 release), NOT 1:1; the CSV SharesOutstanding column is ordinary shares. Held flat: SBC is expensed in the flows; buybacks (US$800m program to Dec-2027, ~US$418m spent by 30-Jun-2026) fund the flat count.
inputs.sbc_source: TTM Jun-2026 = FY2025 343.0 + H1-26 171.8 - H1-25 161.5 (HK$m; FY25 from 20-F XBRL via CSV, H1 from the Q2-26 non-GAAP reconciliation). Company's non-GAAP adjusted NI = NI + SBC with no tax effect; no separate equity-award withholding disclosed.
inputs.buyback_note: Treasury stock HK$3,275.8m at 30-Jun-2026 = repurchases under the Nov-2025 US$800m program (~US$418m, ~3.8m ADS). Plus HK$2.86bn (US$365m) cash dividend paid ~29-Apr-2026. FY2021-23 buybacks in kpis.
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate is HKD->USD (model->quote) = 1/7.8463, Yahoo Finance HKD=X (USD/HKD) close 2026-10-03. Parity checks: (1) the company's own convenience rate HK$7.8420/US$ (Fed H.10 noon buying rate, 30-Jun-2026) is within 0.06%; (2) Q2-26 diluted EPS HK$26.08/ADS = US$3.33/ADS in the release (7.83); (3) HKD is pegged in the HKMA 7.75-7.85 band. Futu has no Hong Kong listing, so no dual-listing parity is available. All flows and per-ADS values are computed in HKD and converted at this rate; the unsuffixed intrinsic values are USD per ADS.
inputs.currency_note: FUTU_Metrics.csv labels every row USD (known build_facts_xbrl.py bug: hardcoded currency). The figures are HKD: FY2017 revenue 311.663 matches the HKD-tagged XBRL value, and FY2025 revenue 22,846.9 / equity 40,321.1 tie to the HK$ columns of the Q2-26 release balance sheet (Dec-25 total equity HK$40,321,122k). Treated as HKD millions throughout.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 11.5% applied to equity flows (HKD, pegged to USD so the USD risk-free basis applies): 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.3 x 5.5% ERP = ~11.4%, rounded to 11.5% for a Cayman/HK-domiciled ADR. Single rate across all three scenarios: the CSRC/mainland wind-down and trading-cycle risks are charged in the bear flows and the bear-tilted weights, not stacked in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Leases immaterial (lease liabilities HK$739m vs HK$38.9bn equity); operating lease cost sits inside operating expenses and therefore inside the margin. No lease liabilities in the bridge.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI immaterial (HK$328m of HK$39.2bn equity; NCI share of H1-26 NI was a HK$24m loss). Flows are total; no bridge deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Futu is an online broker with a HK$95bn margin-financing book, HK$136bn of client cash held on balance sheet and borrowings/repos that fund the margin book. Per dcf-methods routing this is bank/broker-like: reported OCF/FCF is client-money noise (FY23 -HK$6.3bn, FY24 +HK$30.8bn, FY25 +HK$40.7bn, H1-21 -HK$14.4bn) and borrowings are operating funding, so an unlevered owner-FCF DCF is meaningless. Valued as FCFE at the cost of equity on the engine route, the house approach for financials (NAB.AX, BMO, STT, USB): revenue x pre-tax margin (before SBC) -> SBC -> tax = net income; capital retention charged through wc_capture_pct as HK$1.50 of retained equity per HK$1 of incremental revenue (equity/revenue ~1.5x, i.e. ~30% incremental ROE at a ~45% net margin; FY25 equity/revenue was 1.75x including excess capital). net_debt = 0: client payables, borrowings and repos are operating balances; own cash is regulatory working capital and is NOT credited (conservative; no excess-capital add-back). FY0 = TTM to 30-Jun-2026 (FY25 + H1-26 - H1-25) because FY2025 is nine months stale: TTM revenue HK$25,897.6m, op income HK$16,045m (62.0%), Others,net ex-penalty ~-1.8% of revenue, SBC 1.36%, D&A ~0.3%, tax 16-18% effective. FY0 pre-tax margin before SBC = 61.9%. The Q1-26 CSRC penalty provision (HK$2,091m = pre-adjustment Q1 NI 2,922.0 - reported 831.0, booked in Others,net, no tax effect) is excluded from the FY0 margin as non-recurring and deducted once in the equity bridge. TTM NI ex-penalty HK$13,186m; model FY0 NOPAT ~HK$12,860m (2.5% below, mainly equity-method gains not modelled). Interest income is core broker revenue (margin and client-cash spread), not excess-cash income, so it is NOT stripped.

base.ebitda_margin_path_note: Pre-tax margin before SBC and D&A (broker analogue of EBITDA). FY0 61.9%; fades ~5pp as Fed/HKMA cuts compress the client-cash and margin spread, overseas markets (US, Japan, Canada, Australia, Malaysia, Thailand) absorb marketing and the blended commission rate keeps falling.
base.wc_capture_pct_note: Capital retention: HK$1.50 of equity retained per HK$1 of revenue growth (regulatory capital for the margin book and client assets).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: TTM revenue sits on a record trading-volume peak in a business the analysis rates highly cyclical, and there is a live single-regulator risk (unresolved CSRC penalty, eight-agency campaign, CEO personally named). Base 50% for the international growth path management is executing. Bull cut to 20% because it needs a sustained bull market, continued overseas share gains and a benign regulatory outcome all at once.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
